title: Location
description: A location entity as published in PublicGame.locations (Arkham.Location.Base.LocationAttrs plus the computed connection/occupant fields Arkham.Game.withLocationConnectionData merges in). Matcher, cost, and card-union payloads remain intentionally broad; see the field descriptions below for exactly what is out of scope in this slice.

tokens.description: A Token-keyed multiset (e.g. clues, doom, resources), encoded as an array of [tokenName, count] pairs.

connectedMatchers.description: Unrevealed-side connection matchers (Arkham.Matcher.Location.LocationMatcher). Broad and out of scope for this contract slice.

revealedConnectedMatchers.description: Revealed-side connection matchers (Arkham.Matcher.Location.LocationMatcher). Broad and out of scope for this contract slice.

directions.description: A Direction-keyed map of grid-adjacent location ids, encoded as an array of [direction, [locationId, ...]] pairs. Empty for every non-grid scenario (including this fixture's Night of the Zealot board), so the populated pair shape is not asserted here.

connectsTo.description: The set of grid Directions (Above, Below, LeftOf, RightOf) this location opens toward. Empty outside grid-based scenarios.

cardsUnderneath.description: Cards physically stacked underneath this location. Broad card union, out of scope for this contract slice.

costToEnterUnrevealed.description: The Arkham.Cost required to enter this location while unrevealed. Broad tagged union, out of scope for this contract slice.

keys.description: Arkham keys placed on this location. Broad (ArkhamKey nests a ChaosToken and recurses), out of scope for this contract slice.

seals.description: Scarlet Keys campaign seals placed on this location. Broad, out of scope for this contract slice.

floodLevel.description: Edge of the Earth flood-level marker. Broad, out of scope for this contract slice.

brazier.description: Edge of the Earth brazier state. Broad, out of scope for this contract slice.

breaches.description: Breach/collapse status. Broad, out of scope for this contract slice.

globalMeta.description: Free-form shared scenario metadata, keyed by arbitrary string keys.

position.description: The grid position, when this location is placed on a grid-based board. Broad, out of scope for this contract slice.

concealedCards.description: Concealed-card ids hidden at this location. Broad, out of scope for this contract slice.

connectedLocations.description: Computed at snapshot time from directions and the revealed connection matchers: the ids of locations currently reachable from here.

investigators.description: Computed at snapshot time: investigator ids currently at this location.

enemies.description: Computed at snapshot time: enemy ids at or attached to this location. Broad item shape (id format only), out of scope for this contract slice.

assets.description: Computed at snapshot time: asset ids at or attached to this location. Broad item shape, out of scope for this contract slice.

events.description: Computed at snapshot time: event ids at or attached to this location. Broad item shape, out of scope for this contract slice.

treacheries.description: Computed at snapshot time: treachery ids at or attached to this location. Broad item shape, out of scope for this contract slice.

scarletKeys.description: Computed at snapshot time: Scarlet Keys campaign key ids at this location. Broad item shape, out of scope for this contract slice.

modifiers.description: Active modifiers targeting this location. Broad and additive, out of scope for this contract slice.
